title: Constructible geometric exceptional adjunction agrees with the localizing Brown adjoint
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$, with $Y_0$ quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally of finite type over $k_0$, and $X_0$ quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$. Fix its native chosen compactification $X_0\xrightarrow{j_0}Z_0\xrightarrow{p_0}Y_0$, where $j_0$ is open and $p_0$ proper. For $T_0=X_0,Y_0,Z_0$ write $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, and use the locally finite continuous coefficient sheaf $B_T$, its internal module category $\mathcal A_T$, the geometric Frobenius pullback $P_T$, and the fixed-pair heart $\mathcal W_T=\mathcal A_T^{P_T}$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Thus a constructible sheaf has locally a finite locally closed constructible stratification and, on each stratum, a pro-etale covering with finite free model $B_U^{\oplus r_U}$ on each member $U$; ranks may depend on $U$. Put $\mathcal C_T=D^b_{\mathrm{cons}}(\mathcal A_T)$ and $\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal C_T)$, the full replete triangulated closure under small coproducts in the ordinary derived category. Fix one universe for all Hom groups, generating sets and coproducts [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. Write $U_T:D(\mathcal W_T)\to D(\mathcal A_T)$ for derived forgetting, $I_T\dashv U_T$ for exact free induction with $U_TI_TA=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}P_T^nA$ [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution], and $\eta_T$ for its unit. Set $F=Rp_*D(j_!)$ and $F_W=Rp_*^{\mathcal W}D(j_!^{\mathcal W})$, the actual native sheaf operations with their specified coefficient maps and Frobenius lifts, on ordinary unbounded derived categories. Neither scheme is required to be separated over $k_0$.

Use the ordinary common finite coefficient-field categories $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{stage}}_{T,\Omega}=D^b_{ctf}(T,\Omega)$ and the equivalences $J_T:\mathcal C^{\mathrm{stage}}_{T,\Omega}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal C_T$ of [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-constructible-realization]. Let $F^{\mathrm{stage}}\dashv G^{\mathrm{stage}}$ be the constructible exceptional adjunction at $\Omega$ of [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients], with counit $\epsilon^{\mathrm{stage}}$, and let $\alpha:J_YF^{\mathrm{stage}}\xrightarrow{\sim}FJ_X$ be the comparison of [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-realization]. Choose an inverse equivalence $J_Y^{-1}$ with counit $e_Y:J_YJ_Y^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$. Then
$$G_c=J_XG^{\mathrm{stage}}J_Y^{-1}:\mathcal C_Y\longrightarrow\mathcal C_X$$
is right adjoint to $F|_{\mathcal C_X}$. Its Hom bijection is the transport through $J_Y^{-1},J_X$ of the stage adjunction, and its counit at $M\in\mathcal C_Y$ is
$$FG_cM\xrightarrow{\alpha_{G^{\mathrm{stage}}J_Y^{-1}M}^{-1}}J_YF^{\mathrm{stage}}G^{\mathrm{stage}}J_Y^{-1}M\xrightarrow{J_Y\epsilon^{\mathrm{stage}}}J_YJ_Y^{-1}M\xrightarrow{e_{Y,M}}M.$$
For any right adjoint $G$ to $F:\mathcal L_X\to\mathcal L_Y$, transposing this counit gives a natural isomorphism
$$t:G_c\xrightarrow{\sim}G|_{\mathcal C_Y}$$
in $\mathcal L_X$. In particular $G(\mathcal C_Y)\subset\mathcal C_X$. For every $M\in\mathcal C_Y$, every $A\in\mathcal C_X$ and every integer $n$, the map $\operatorname{Hom}(A[n],t_M)$ is the composite of the constructible and ambient adjunction bijections; a cone $Q_M$ of $t_M$ has $\operatorname{Hom}(B[n],Q_M)=0$ for every $B\in\mathcal L_X$ and every $n$. All these assertions concern ordinary derived Hom groups and the actual native locally finite coefficient sheaf.

proof.text: Use RX.image and the compact-support comparison alpha to represent F(K) as J_Y(F_stage(A)) whenever K is represented by J_X(A). This proves preservation without a separate repleteness assumption. Lift alpha to the full constructible subcategory. Compose the inverse realization adjunction J_X^{-1} ⊣ J_X, the given stage adjunction, and J_Y ⊣ J_Y^{-1}. Transport its left functor across the isomorphism from J_X^{-1} F_stage J_Y to F_c induced by alpha and the counit of J_X. This yields F_c ⊣ J_Y^{-1} G_stage J_X using Mathlib Adjunction.comp and ofNatIsoLeft. These constructions are the natural Hom-bijection construction of lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection.

proof.text: Expand the counit of the composite and transported adjunction. Naturality of alpha inverse moves F_stage of the inverse J_X-unit across alpha inverse, and the J_X counit cancels its inverse. What remains is alpha inverse followed by J_Y of the stage counit and then the J_Y counit. For the prescribed Hom formula at J_X(K), apply the inverse constructible Hom bijection to the proposed J_X-image. Use the counit formula, alpha naturality, the inverse stage Hom formula and full faithfulness of J_Y. Its image is the original arrow, so injectivity gives exactly the prescribed Hom transport.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint, counit as the inverse image of the identity

proof.text:
Let $\Phi$ be the Hom bijection for the supplied ambient adjunction $F\dashv G$, with counit $\epsilon^G$, and define $t_M=\Phi_{G_cM,M}(\epsilon^c_M)$. It satisfies $\epsilon^G_M\circ F(t_M)=\epsilon^c_M$. For $v:M\to N$, the inverse transposes of $G(v)t_M$ and $t_NG_c(v)$ are respectively $v\epsilon^c_M$ and $\epsilon^c_NF(G_c(v))$; these are equal by naturality of $\epsilon^c$. Injectivity of $\Phi^{-1}$ proves naturality of $t$. For $a:A[n]\to G_cM$, naturality in the source gives
$$t_Ma=\Phi_{A[n],M}(\epsilon^c_MF(a))=\Phi_{A[n],M}(\Psi^{-1}_{A[n],M}(a)).$$
Here $A[n]\in\mathcal C_X$ since the realization equivalence is triangulated. Thus every required postcomposition map is the composite of the stated two bijections.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint, naturality and counit formula for inverse transposes

proof.text: For each M apply lem-sf-localizing-hom-test in the full ordinary derived category to the underlying map t_M. Its endpoints have the localizing-closure property by the codomains of the inclusions and G. For a shifted constructible generator A[n], use the actual constructible object with underlying object A[n]. The fully faithful inclusions identify both Hom sets with ambient derived Hom sets. Postcomposition by t_M is the composition of the inverse constructible adjunction bijection, the identity-on-underlying-arrows inclusion, and the ambient adjunction bijection, by step 3. Hence it is bijective. The Hom test proves the component is invertible; full faithfulness reflects this to the hull and pointwise invertibility yields a natural isomorphism. To prove constructibility of GM, represent G_cM as J_X(K) using RX.image and compose that representation with the component isomorphism, then apply RX.image in the other direction.

source.place: Final exceptional-adjunction assertion, expanded by the existing arbitrary-class localizing Hom test

proof.text: Any cone $Q_M$ sits in a distinguished triangle $G_cM\xrightarrow{t_M}GM\to Q_M\to G_cM[1]$. The zero-cone criterion applied to the isomorphism of step 4 says that $Q_M$ is a zero object. Therefore every map $B[n]\to Q_M$ is zero, for every $B\in\mathcal L_X$ and integer $n$. All Hom bijections above were taken in the full ordinary derived subcategories, so no replacement of the native coefficient sheaf or of the ordinary derived Hom is involved.
